basic_details.post_name: Project Technical Support- III, Project Research Scientist- I (non-medical), and Project Research Scientist- II (Medical)
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) has published a notification for 3 vacancies, covering Project Technical Support- III, Project Research Scientist- I (non-medical), and Project Research Scientist- II (Medical) posts on a contract basis. Qualifications and age limits vary by post. The engagement is initially for one year, with a pay of Rs. 33,600 to Rs. 96,000. Eligible applicants must fill the prescribed application form, attach the CV and supporting documents as a single PDF file, and submit their application by email on or before 27 November 2026.

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Project Technical Support- III: Maximum 35 years. Project Research Scientist- I (non-medical): Maximum 35 years. Project Research Scientist- II (Medical): Maximum 40 years.

qualification.education_qualification: BSc Emergency Medicine Technicians/ Nursing/Operation Theatre Technology with three years post qualification experience
qualification.details: Project Technical Support- III: BSc Emergency Medicine Technicians, Nursing, Operation Theatre Technology with Three years post qualification experience. Project Research Scientist- I (non-medical): Master’s in public health (MPH), MSc Public Health, MSc Epidemiology, MSc Clinical Research, MSc Nursing, A relevant master’s in health sciences or health services research. Project Research Scientist- II (Medical): MBBS/BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/ MDS/MPH) or equivalent, or MBBS/BDS with PhD, with three years’ post qualification experience.

salary_details.project technical support- iii: Rs 33600/- per month (Rs 28000 + 20% HRA) (no other allowances are payable)
salary_details.project research scientist- i (non-medic: Rs 67200/- per month (Rs 56000 + 20% HRA) (no other allowances are payable)
salary_details.project research scientist- ii (medical): Rs 96000/- per month (Rs 80000 + 20% HRA) (no other allowances are payable)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Project Research Scientist- II (Medical) recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Project Research Scientist- II (Medical) in the ICMR-funded project at the Department of Emergency Medicine and Trauma, JIPMER.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Complete applications must be emailed by 5 PM on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: MBBS/BDS with a Post Graduate Degree (MD/MDS/MPH) or equivalent degree, or MBBS/BDS with three years' post qualification experience, or MBBS/BDS with PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs 96000/- per month, made up of Rs 80000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any allowance paid on top of the Rs 96000?
faq.answer: No. The Rs 96000 already includes 20% HRA on Rs 80000, and the notice says no other allowances or facilities are payable beyond the consolidated salary.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form with CV and supporting documents, scanned in one PDF, to [email protected], with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applicants are first shortlisted on application, CV and documents. Final selection is based on CV, application and written test/interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract position, initially for one year and extendable up to the project end on 30.11.2029, with no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application form must be filled for each post, and each must be sent with its enclosures in a separate email.
